name: design-md
description: Write or update a DESIGN.md for a project: the colors, type scale, spacing, corners, shadows and components it really uses, with rules an AI agent can follow so every new screen matches. Use when asked to document a design system, create a DESIGN.md or style guide, or stop an agent from inventing new styles; also to start a new project from a real website design system with UXKIN (optional).
